story:
SETS (make each one a cast member of kind "set" and give every shot the set of the place it shows):
1. Brighton seafront: the pier and its shingle beach by the sea (kit place: beach); morning wind, afternoon, golden dusk
2. Grandfather's kitchen with a wooden table and a window (kit place: kitchen); morning light

KEY OBJECT (the owner's notes — draw it exactly so): Maya's red diamond kite: a red sail on a cross of thin bamboo sticks, a tail of small bows, flown on a string. States in order: intact (smooth taut sail) → torn (a jagged hole with a flap of sail hanging down and the sky showing through it) → patched (a white cloth patch over the hole with visible stitches) → starred (the same patch with a big gold star painted on it).

On a windy autumn morning in Brighton, eight-year-old Maya flies her red kite above the pier. A gust slams it into the pier railings, and the red sail tears from corner to corner. Maya runs home along the seafront, the broken kite hugged to her chest. Her grandfather, who mended sails when he was young, looks up from his newspaper. At the kitchen table he lays the kite flat and threads a needle with sailcloth thread. Stitch by stitch, he shows Maya how a sailor's seam holds against the wind. Maya paints a small gold star over the patch, so the kite will remember. In the afternoon they walk back to the beach together, the kite under Grandfather's arm. Maya runs into the wind, and the kite climbs higher than ever over the waves. She hands the string to her grandfather, and he laughs like a boy. At golden dusk they walk home along the sand, the mended kite on Maya's shoulder.

bible.title: The Red Kite

states.look: smooth taut red sail on thin bamboo cross, tail of small white bows, flown on a white string
jagged hole from corner to corner with a flap of sail hanging down, sky visible through the tear
white cloth patch covering the hole, visible stitches around the edges
same white patch with a big gold star painted in the center

parts.look: taut, smooth red fabric forming a perfect diamond shape, about 60cm wide and 80cm tall, vivid red with a slight sheen like ripstop nylon

two thin, straight bamboo spars crossing at the exact center — one vertical spine, one horizontal spreader — each about 5mm thick, pale tan with visible nodes, ends tucked into sail pockets at the four diamond points
a single thin white line trailing from the bottom diamond point, 2–3 times the kite height long, dotted every 15cm with tiny white fabric bows (2cm loops), fluttering loose
thin white cotton line tied to the bridle point where the spars cross, running upward and out of frame, taut when flown

states.change: smooth taut red sail on thin bamboo cross, tail of small white bows, flown on a white string
a jagged hole tearing from the left corner to the right corner, a triangular flap of red sail hanging down from the top edge, bright sky visible through the gap
a rectangular white cloth patch covering the hole, coarse visible stitches in white thread running around all four edges of the patch
the same white patch now bearing a large, flat gold five-pointed star painted in its center, star points nearly touching the patch edges

shots.description: Wide shot of Brighton seafront at morning wind: Maya stands on the pier, red kite soaring high above the railings, sea glittering, golden light.
shots.dialogue: On a windy autumn morning in Brighton, eight-year-old Maya flies her red kite above the pier.

shots.description: Medium shot close to pier railings as a sudden gust slams the kite into the wood, the red sail rips from corner to corner, a jagged hole flaps, sky shows through.
shots.dialogue: A gust slams it into the pier railings, and the red sail tears from corner to corner.

shots.description: Pan along the shingle beach as Maya runs toward home, the torn kite hugged to her chest, wind tugging her coat.
shots.dialogue: Maya runs home along the seafront, the broken kite hugged to her chest.

shots.description: Close-up inside grandfather's kitchen, morning light through window, grandfather looks up from newspaper, curious.
shots.dialogue: Her grandfather, who mended sails when he was young, looks up from his newspaper.

shots.description: Slow zoom-in on wooden table as grandfather lays the torn kite flat, threads a needle with sailcloth thread, steady hands.
shots.dialogue: At the kitchen table he lays the kite flat and threads a needle with sailcloth thread.

shots.description: Close-up of grandfather's hands stitching a sailor's seam, each stitch pulls the torn edges together, Maya watches intently.
shots.dialogue: Stitch by stitch, he shows Maya how a sailor's seam holds against the wind.

shots.description: Slow zoom-in on Maya's fingertips painting a big gold star on the white patch, the star glints in the morning light.
shots.dialogue: Maya paints a small gold star over the patch, so the kite will remember.

shots.description: Wide shot of Brighton seafront in afternoon, Maya and grandfather walk side by side along the sand, kite tucked under grandfather's arm, beach huts colorful.
shots.dialogue: In the afternoon they walk back to the beach together, the kite under Grandfather's arm.

shots.description: Low angle shot from the sand as Maya runs into the wind, the starred kite lifts higher than ever over rolling waves, string taut.
shots.dialogue: Maya runs into the wind, and the kite climbs higher than ever over the waves.

shots.description: Medium shot from behind Maya as she hands the string to grandfather, he laughs like a boy, kite dancing in the breeze.
shots.dialogue: She hands the string to her grandfather, and he laughs like a boy.

shots.description: Wide shot at golden dusk, Maya and grandfather stroll home along the shoreline, the mended kite rests on Maya's shoulder, sea calm, lantern glow from pier.
shots.dialogue: At golden dusk they walk home along the sand, the mended kite on Maya's shoulder.
